verdict.rationale: Rippling's own pages position its HR platform as the single source of truth for employee data. They state that when roles change or someone leaves, it automatically updates access, permissions and groups, provisioning accounts through dynamic rules and federating to AD, LDAP, SCIM and SAML apps. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, explicit documentation of joiner-to-directory (AD/LDAP) write-back, detailed docs on mover/leaver app-assignment mechanics beyond marketing copy.

support.subject: As an IT admin, HR drives identity — the HRIS is the source of truth, and joiner/mover/leaver changes flow into the directory and app assignments automatically

citations.quote: The Rippling platform is built on a single source of truth for employee data
When roles changes or someone leaves, Rippling automatically updates access, permissions, and groups.
From provisioning accounts to managing group access, dynamic rules automatically ensure the right people get the right level of access—even as their roles change.
Federated identity lets you handle any protocol with ease—from LDAP, Active Directory (AD), OIDC, and RADIUS, to custom SCIM and SAML apps.
automatically provisions or revokes access based on role changes, risk signals, and company policy
